\[

= \Pr(U \le F(x)) \quad \text{(apply } F \text{ to both sides, since } F \text{ is monotone)} 
\]

Because \(U\) is uniform on \([0,1]\), \(\Pr(U \le y) = y\) for \(y \in [0,1]\). Hence,

\[
\Pr(U \le F(x)) = F(x).
\]

So the cdf of \(Y\) is exactly \(F\), meaning \(Y \sim F\).
